task: Compute cloud-to-cloud distances between /home/user/Documents/compared.ply and /home/user/Documents/reference.ply. Both are ASCII PLYs with 1000 points each; reference.ply is the same planar patch as compared.ply shifted by +2 units along Z. Attach the per-point distances to compared.ply as a scalar field and export the result as an ASCII PLY at /home/user/Documents/compared_c2c.ply with all 1000 points and the distance scalar field.
task_grounding: Open /home/user/Documents/compared.ply and /home/user/Documents/reference.ply in CloudCompare. Both are ASCII PLYs with 1000 points each; reference.ply is the same planar patch as compared.ply shifted by +2 units along Z. Select compared.ply as the compared entity and reference.ply as the reference, then run Tools > Distances > Cloud/Cloud dist to compute per-point cloud-to-cloud distances. Accept the default settings. This attaches a scalar field containing the per-point distances to compared.ply. Export the resulting compared cloud (with its scalar field) as an ASCII PLY at /home/user/Documents/compared_c2c.ply. The exported file must include an extra scalar (distance) property per vertex beyond x,y,z, and the 1000-point count must be preserved.

verification.description: Scalar field property present beyond x,y,z

cli_feasibility.translation: Use CloudCompare CLI: cli-anything-cloudcompare export cloud INDEX output.ply --preset ply [--overwrite]
cli_feasibility.reason: CLI has 'export cloud' command supporting multiple formats (PLY binary/ASCII, LAS, XYZ, etc.) with format-specific options.
